status: Matt’s confirmed business answers are applied to the private replies. All customer prices in replies include GST. Unconfirmed supplementary prices stay out of automatic answers. No live publication or message delivery is enabled.

Minimum AUD $100 for servicing and AUD $300 for dyno bookings after date approval. Timely communicated date changes can transfer the deposit with PSI’s agreement. No invented notice cutoff. Standard cancellation retention is qualified by applicable consumer rights and circumstances. Boost does not decide or process refunds.

Generally valid for 7 to 14 days at most, with the written expiry controlling. Expired quotes need review because supplier prices, stock and import exchange rates change. No automatic repricing of accepted work.

Request receipts, part details and inspection paperwork before PSI checks suitability and safety. PSI offers a workmanship warranty. Modified engine and supplier coverage need written scope. No blanket denial of consumer guarantees or automatic rejection of a failure claim.
No loan cars. Towing, pickup and vehicle transport are between the customer and their transport provider. Workshop arrival needs agreement with PSI.
